page.overview:
What is Orange Dye?

Orange dye is a quasi-primary dye crafted from orange tulips, or by combining one red dye with one yellow dye.

Wandering traders sell 3 orange dye for an emerald.

Apprentice-level shepherd villagers have a 20% chance to buy 12 orange dye for an emerald as part of their trades.

Journeyman-level shepherd villagers have a chance to buy 12 orange dye for an emerald.
